title: pages.block.update_text
description: Replace the text of a single page block, optionally guarded by the block's expected prior content hash so a concurrent edit records a failure instead of clobbering.

block_id.description: The block to rewrite (a page root's text is its title).

expected_hash.description: Optional guard: sha256 over the block's current text bytes. A mismatch records a failure instead of overwriting.

text.$comment: maxLength counts Unicode code points (JSON Schema semantics); the docs-harness module enforces MAX_BLOCK_TEXT_BYTES (65536 UTF-8 bytes) instead. Multi-byte text can pass this schema check and still be rejected by the module — the module is the stricter, authoritative bound, and that rejection is a clean probe reject, not a bug.
